text:
lena: quick stand 10m1 to align on the launch post + webinar against cloud AI platforms and LLM APIs. primary goal: shorten eval-to-purchase by surfacing predictable econ + reliability.

omar: focus pillars: predictable unit economics, graceful fallback, and private options. avoid calling out competitor names.

jen: benchmark idea: customer-facing bullets + one link to appendix. e.g. 'sustained throughput: 25% lower $/1M tokens in production vs unmanaged endpoints' and '95th-pctl tail latency within SLA across burst patterns'. keep numbers rounded.

mike: webinar format proposal: 25m total. 8m benchmark narrative, 7m demo (routing + fallback + cost dashboard), 6m customer case (short), 4m Q&A. CTA: schedule dedicated trial or self-serve sandbox.

sam: inbound routing rules to tag leads by intent: proof-seeker, compliance, cost-optimization, platform-eval. SDR playbooks per tag. snippet samples below.

ops-bot: ```
inbound_rules:
  - match: "benchmark" OR "latency"
    tag: proof-seeker
    assign_to: webinar-nurture
  - match: "on-prem" OR "vpc" OR "compliance"
    tag: compliance
    assign_to: enterprise-sdr
  - match: "cost" OR "optimize"
    tag: cost-eval
    assign_to: econ-sdr
```

eli: SDR snippets (subject / opener):
- proof-seeker: "Quick note on the benchmark you asked about" / "Hi — wanted to share a short one-pager that explains our test setup and results."
- compliance: "Private deployment options + audit controls" / "We have a VPC/on-prem flow and KMS integrations. Can we set a time to review?"
- cost-eval: "Ways to cut token spend when scaling" / "Short checklist: batching, prefix caching, model quant profile."

jen: appendix plan: 3 charts (sustained throughput $/token, tail-latency CDF, cost vs batch size), 1 methodology slide, reproducible test link. no raw logs.

omar: messaging tone: confident, engineering-first, production-proven. steer away from 'best' claims. use comparative framing: 'vs unmanaged cloud endpoints' or 'typical LLM API flows'. include callouts for dedicated/private.

lena: promo cadence: 1) short launch post w/ 3 bullets + link to appendix 2) targeted LinkedIn doc for infra/platform buyers 3) webinar in 10 business days 4) post-webinar nurture. A/B test headlines: 'Predictable LLM economics for production' vs 'Keep inference fast when traffic spikes'.

mike: marketing ops checklist: registration page, calendar invite, demo environment with scripted scenarios, customer panel confirmed. I'll own logistics.

sam: I'll wire SDR playbook drafts into #marketing-distro. propose canned replies and 2 subject-line variations per tag.

jen: timeline ok. I'll deliver appendix draft + three chart images by Tue EOD.

eli: I'll produce the SDR snippets by tomorrow morning and mock subject lines.

ops-bot: reminder: create webinar registration page when assets uploaded.

lena: decision recap: jen -> appendix, eli -> SDR snippets, mike -> webinar logistics, sam -> routing rules + playbook. owners to update thread when done. thanks all. :sparkles:
